note: ALL 218 SUBJECTS, ruling C93, so the silence is countable. Each row points at a device key in window.ARDA_HERALD or declares itself bare with the measured reason. No device is drawn here and none is duplicated: 208 subjects share 152 devices, because the corpus gives one running horse to six bearers and one white tree to nine.
axes: `basis` is the HALL's axis and answers how the archive came to have the picture: artwork ✔ a device Tolkien designed, shown as a recreation · design ✦ a device he drew that cannot be reproduced here, drawn by the forge from his description and from arrangements and inks measured off the plates · text ✧ blazoned in the texts and never drawn · inferred ◆ the archive's own interpretation, where he left no device · silent ○ nothing recorded anywhere, and the field is left bare rather than filled in. `conf` is the ROSTER's axis and answers how strong the evidence is that this subject bears it: [C] the corpus names the charge AS a device of this subject · [I-H] it attests the image but not as heraldry, or attests it for the parent of a branch · [I-M] a longer chain · null refused. THEY ARE NOT ONE AXIS AND NEITHER IS DERIVED FROM THE OTHER: a device whose picture is `artwork` can be attached to a subject at [I-H], and a subject can be [C] on a device whose picture is `inferred`.
